messages:
Ana (Sales): Kestrel wants to convert POC -> pilot. Procurement sent back an order form but attached an MSA with DPA/SLA redlines. They want net60, PO on first page, and a vendor-managed KMS clause for hosted. Can legal + finance advise?
Tom (Legal): Share the PDF. My quick read: vendor-managed KMS for hosted is a big ask. Also subprocessor notice is 7 days which is too short.
Ana (Sales): Uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/KEST-msa-redline.pdf. Procurement insists net60 from activation and PO on page 1.
Jin (Finance): Net60 from activation is higher risk. We prefer net45 from signed date. If first invoice > $100k, CFO approval required. We can accept net60 only with payment milestones (e.g., 30% on signing). PO before activation is preferred.
Ravi (Eng): For the POC we can host in eu-west-2. Customer-managed KMS on hosted will require dedicated tenancy and HSM access; that moves this likely to Dedicated pricing.
Tom (Legal): Proposed approach: (1) decline vendor-managed KMS for hosted; offer CMK option limited to Dedicated/Private with security scoping, (2) change subprocessor notification to 30 days with 72-hour emergency notice, (3) add SOC2/pen-test attestation timeline. Ill prepare a redline.
Ana (Sales): DocuSign routing request: procurement -> legal review -> finance -> exec. They also want a checkbox "PO attached" required to finish signature. Can SignBot do that?
SignBot: Envelope draft `KEST-OF-2179990001` created. Template includes a required checkbox "PO attached" and header field for PO number to print on page 1 if populated. Sandbox URL: https://docusign.redwood/ENVELOPE/2179990001.
Jin (Finance): If PO not received within 7 business days after signing, we hold activation. If they want net60 from activation, require 50% on signing. Also confirm billing email and PO format.
Ravi (Eng): I'll prepare a 1-page data residency appendix clarifying eu-west-2 processing, log retention, and PII redaction options. Will attach to order form.
Tom (Legal): Uploaded our redline: https://redwood.app/drive/KEST-msa-our-redline.pdf. Key summary: vendor-managed KMS only for Dedicated; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys with documented controls; subprocessor notice 30 days; indemnity scope narrowed; added SLA uptime and remedies section.
Ana (Sales): Sending redline + envelope to buyer. Quick ask: can DocuSign include PO field in the first page header automatically?
SignBot: Yes. If PO field populated before sending, it will render on page 1 header. If not, the checkbox blocks completion.
Jin (Finance): Confirm net60 baseline: we prefer net45 from signed date. If customer insists net60, escalate to CFO. Also request PO within 48 hours of signing to avoid billing delays.
Ana (Sales): Action items: Tom finalize redline by EOD, SignBot set envelope to route and block without PO, Jin confirm CFO threshold, Ravi attach residency appendix. I'll collect PO contact from procurement.
Tom (Legal): Adding negotiation language for compensating controls if customer pushes on keys (audit escrow, dedicated tenancy at premium).
Ana (Sales): Thanks team 44d. Will update when PO/ack received.
